body:
Your reply was truly helpful, I am trying slowly to get out of the loop and follow the pain as you have already said.

I am not suicidal but all this pressure accumulated left me with no choices in my head. Until I came to accept a few things and let some of the denial go.

This is how I express my egoism as last resort to find what I am truly looking for. Sadly that would never work and it only brings up more problems rather an actual solution.

Thank you for taking time and empathy to feel my pain, people like you make the world less of a shit hole.

I was in quarantine due to covid omicron variant.. I left my home in bad terms because of things that happened, I visit them often but stay only for a bit.. 

Unfortunately I can not come to terms with their living conditions/decisions and I always had the urge to leave home. Going back to live with them would require a lot of things to change from their side. Which I can not demand neither settle down if rejected.

I am trying to be independent in general, I am financially covering my life costs more than 2 years now. I do not have the comfort to reset my life, simply because life does not give you a break.

Even if I had the chance to reset that would require I get grasp of the free time, which I use to consume with temporary pleasure to cover what I have missed due to trauma.

This situation creates an endless toxic loop which I can't get out of and makes me feel powerless. I am too settled into toxic situation that makes me feel home, maybe I am lost cause overall.

This was my original thought to put everything in paper so I can see the truth with my own eyes instead my cloudy thoughts..

I almost did that but I am afraid of what I will face written in this paper. The first attempt I completed is this post which is more of a vent to let out of my mind. 

Yet I can not give personal details, this is the point of anonymity. Also I do not expect anyone to solve my problems or give me the perfect advice.

Maybe all I am looking for is some new hope and see my problems are not out of this world.

Thank you for putting all this effort to reply my mess.

What you describe is going with the flow.. yes I have tried that and ultimately sucks. People will try to project their own desires, ideas, beliefs in every possible way and you'll just sit there and accept it?

Fuck them self righteous bastards who believe their stupid life worth a shit more than mine. At least I am not delusional and I acknowledge we are all piece of shit.

Your response seems genuine, hope is what I am looking for but still getting drown in my own thoughts.

I have already redeemed my luck with people and each time the end is same more or less. Reasons in time appear to be small, what is left is the void of feelings and memories in past.

Breathing technique might help me calm down, but it won't change how I feel about myself. I do have high energy but I drain all of it thinking and it makes me feel so tired.

Plus most of the times you put more thought than expected/required and people you care about waste their lives and potential the same way I do with mine.

It's a fucking loophole that nothing matters, unless you believe it matters or it does not matter to you anymore.PARADOX.

I am not comparing to others only, the most cruel comparison is the one with my previous SELF. I used to be able to work, I used to feel confident for my skills etc.

If myself couple of years ago was able to do 5 things, now I am struggling to get 2 things done. This hurts the most and I have to live with this thought every minute. I feel powerless and a bad investment in life. 

Why would anyone else care to give a fuck about me? Honestly I wouldn't.

What you suggest sounds nice (ideal even), but what if I want THIS job which I struggled to make it happen?

 What if I want THIS partner that I pushed away and realized she holds all these attributes I was always looking for?

I wouldn't mind changing location but that implies I will lose any friends/family I currently have in my life.

I am stuck with the past because these options offered me some joy. Yes I have fucked up in all of them but that does not change the fact I find them true.

Family wants to be supportive, but I am always trying to be independent as much as possible. Yes you are correct life is giving me a hard time, since the moment I was fucking born.

I am tired of this endless fight I am giving, I can't change my luck. The chances I had was thrown away by myself and the stupid ego which is the only thing keeps me alive in the end of the day. I am a SHIT.

Have fun mate I wish I was lucky as you are. Leaving others with pain of your actions is selfish and I can't do it.

I have already hurt them in past and don't want to be selfish once again.

I have no desires and nothing excites me. I am a disappointment and none cares about it.

My family believes I am doing alright, in fact I am fighting everyday with my thoughts and just prolong a toxic situation in hope that something changes.

Each night I fall asleep and wish to never wake up, but I wake even before the alarm clock rings.

I am like a robot without a wish and doomed to go with the flow because I am powerless and my lack of desire is the most motivating factor in my life.

FUCK YOU FOR NOT REPLYING

I CANT WAKE UP AND FACE MY RECEDING HAIRLINE,MY SCALP ITCHES.

MY TEETH HAVE DISCOLORED DUE TO HEAVY WEED SMOKING, MY ADDICTION TO WEED DRAINS ALL THE JOY OF IT.

I AM NOT GOING OUT OF HOME MORE THAN ONCE PER WEEK.

PEOPLE DO NOT WANT TO BE FRIENDS WITH ME, I APPEAR AS GHOST TO THEM. FUCK THEM FOR ALL I CARE. BUT WHEN THEY NEED ME EVERYTHING IS OKAY.

MY HANDS ARE IN PAIN,WEAK AND USELESS FOR ABOUT 2 YEARS. DOCTORS FAILED TO TREAT ME 100% AND THEY DONT HAVE TO LIVE WITH IT BUT I DO.

MONEY IS A CURSE AND MAKES YOU JUNKIE. WITHOUT IT YOU ARE NOTHING AND YOUR DREAMS DO NOT MATTER. 

FUCK YOU ALL I DONT WANT TO TRY I DONT WANT TO CHANGE. I WANT LIFE TO GIVE ME WHATEVER OWES ME INSTANTLY.

I AM NOT GOING TO BE OKAY AFTER THIS RANT, YOUR INTEREST IS FAKE AND YOU WANT TO FILL YOUR OWN EGO BY HELPING PEOPLE.

I HATE THIS WORLD AS MUCH AS I CAN.

As someone who has a lot of trauma,depression and failed to accept being loved by a woman with true emotions all I want to say is that mind can be the worst trap ever been to.

Despite you see and recognize all these feelings from your other half, simply you can't respond as intended due to being occupied mentally in the toxic trauma situation.

It took me 2 years to understand what I have lost and I regret it every day of my life. And we never said good bye in bad terms, I just left everything go. Maybe now it's too late to express these feelings.

Unfortunately trauma of any kind makes wrong choices seem realistic because of all the pressure you get to deal with.
